name: Identifier
label: Identifier
description: A unique character string or persistent identifier that unambiguously distinguishes this study. (OMIABIS:0000006)

name: Name
label: Name
description: The official title, full name, or public label designating this study or research project. (OMIABIS:0000037)

name: Description
label: Description
description: A narrative summary outlining the scientific background, main objectives, and overall scope of the study. (OMIABIS:0000036)

name: StudyUrl
label: Study URL
description: A resolvable web address, digital object identifier (DOI) link, or persistent public repository URL pointing to the study documentation, trial registration, or associated online publication. (NCIT:C42743)

name: InclusionCriteria
label: Inclusion criteria
description: The primary medical, demographic, or genetic eligibility criteria required for a participant to be enrolled in this study. (OBI:0500027)

name: PrincipalInvestigator
label: Principal investigator
description: The primary scientific leader, lead researcher, or designated contact person responsible for the design, execution, and integrity of the study. (OMIABIS:0000100)

name: ContactInformation
label: Contact information
description: An email address for the purpose of contacting the study contact person. (OMIABIS:0000035)

name: StudyDesign
label: Study design
description: The methodological framework and operational protocol specification describing how subjects, biospecimens, and data are structured and collected (e.g. cohort, case-control, longitudinal, cross-sectional). (OBI:0500000)

name: StartDate
label: Start date
description: The date on which this study began. (NCIT:C69208)

name: CompletionDate
label: Completion date
description: The date on which all study protocols are finalized, participant follow-ups conclude, or the primary research objectives are fully met. (NCIT:C142702)
